text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while watching videos during 
lunch break...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
(La-la-la-la-la-la-la-la♪ 
La-la-la-la-la-la♪) (Upbeat BGM)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Good day. Welcome to 'Gentildonna's Room'.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"On this show, we invite guests each time 
and enjoy a free and open conversation."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Our guests this time are... the members of 
the "Golden Clan," it seems.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Any bad kids 'round here?! Even sushi rice 
needs vinegar!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We love sushi more than life itself! 
Today, we, the "OGON Girls," are here to 
hijack the show!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Been having trouble falling asleep lately— 
Well, here's good news for little ol' 
Golshi!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"I heard there was a..., so don't ya got 
anything?"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Go to the gym.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Keep moving until your body craves rest. 
Do that, and sleep will come naturally.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Yes. Next.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Public morals at the academy are in 
complete disarray! This officer must do 
something about it!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Build your strength.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
As long as I have that, dominating the 
field will be child's play.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Did you know? The truly strong make the 
masses straighten their backs just by 
existing.

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
I-I understand what you're saying, but...! 
I cannot agree to suppression by military 
force!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Is there something you wish to say?

text_block_list.name: Orfevre
text_block_list.text:
Someone is acting insolent before the 
King. How unpleasant.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
...Oh? There is such a person? Besides me, 
that is.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Chuckle... An insolent attitude, you say? 
Should one not simply make such an 
opponent yield?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
For those who will not bend to your will, 
you need only show them your "might."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Assuming, of course, that your 'partner' 
isn't someone far stronger than you. 
Hohoho..."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I look up from my smartphone and catch my 
breath. It seems the basic premise of this 
show is answering the guests' troubles, 
but—
choice_data_list:
All your solutions are purely brute force, 
huh...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Haha, you're pretty funny. Solving 
everything with brute force, huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Still, there are some things brute 
strength can't change. What will you do 
when you hit that kind of wall?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: I would never hit such a wall.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It can be crushed. With these very hands.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Something that cannot be changed by power? 
Hohoho—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
No such thing exists in this world, you 
know.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...! Ahahahaha! You've got a few loose 
screws yourself!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Still, yeah. Fascinating! I'm genuinely 
intrigued by your journey. Just how far 
you can go with those values of yours—"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Ah. It's already time.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Well then, that's all for this week. Have 
a good day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, "Gentildonna's Room" came to an 
abrupt end—her time management really was 
an act of pure brute force.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It seems the Golden Clan series is split 
across several videos... Other thumbnails 
were displayed on the smartphone.
choice_data_list:
Ten minutes left of lunch break, huh... 
Yeah, I can make it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, there's no time to watch multiple 
ones. Here, I should—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Courses with long home stretches are 
still tough for me after all... Even 
though I've been training for them."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
How about you, Ms. Gentile? If there are 
any courses you struggle with... I'd love 
for us to discuss strategies together.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
My, what an amusing thing to say. As if I 
had any weaknesses—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Do I appear that fragile to you?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. That's true. You've always been 
that kind of person.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: —Yes, please.

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
...Hah. Again? This game is 'High & Low', 
you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Just mindlessly declaring 'I'm in' ain't 
gonna win ya anything. You get that, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Oh, didn't you know? The truly strong... 
have even luck on their side, you know?

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Ngh... Hahahahaha! Now things are getting 
interesting!

text_block_list.name: Nakayama Festa
text_block_list.text:
Come on, flip it, my grand lady. Let's see 
whose luck comes out on top— your everyday 
fortune, or my gambler's luck—!
